title: Convert Remodel Document Crate to Dsl Derive Engine
description: Convert remodel/rs/lib.rs (package remodel_document) from its hand-rolled `impl DocumentDsl for RemodelScene` / `impl OpText for RemodelOperation` / private `mod remodel_text` lexer-parser onto the declarative dsl:: derive engine (dsl::DslDocument/DslRecord/DslScalar/DslEnum/DslOps), following the established cheat sheet procedure from prior waves (fem/2d, process/3d, imperative/core, infinite/board/port/directed/dag). Handle the foreign MeshData type (from semio-framework-core) via local twin or existing bridge, Box<RemodelMesh> in RemodelOperation/RemodelDiff variants, and the PackedF32/PackedU8 base64-string newtype wrappers. Do not touch other remodel/* sub-crates or vcs/dsl engine crates themselves. Verify with cargo test -p remodel_document and cargo build for the remodel plugin crate.
summary:
Converted remodel_document (remodel/rs/lib.rs) from its hand-rolled impl DocumentDsl/impl OpText + private mod remodel_text lexer/parser (~1550 lines deleted) onto the dsl:: derive engine. Added #[derive(dsl::DslRecord)] to every plain-data struct, #[derive(dsl::DslScalar)] (with explicit kebab-case #[dsl(key=...)] tags matching the old serde wire format) to every unit enum, #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)] + #[dsl(extension="remodel")] to RemodelScene, and #[derive(dsl::DslOps)] + per-variant #[dsl(key="setX")] to RemodelOperation. RemodelDiff (a separate CRDT-only type, never part of the old text grammar) was left untouched. Foreign-type handling: MeshData (from semio-framework-core, out of scope) can't get a derived dsl::DslField via the orphan rule, so RemodelMesh keeps mesh: MeshData exactly as-is (remodel/plugin builds/reads it directly) and instead gets a hand-written impl dsl::DslField for RemodelMesh (bypassing the derive), routing the mesh field through a new private MeshDataTwin (#[derive(dsl::DslRecord)]) that packs every numeric buffer through PackedF32/PackedU8 plus a new private PackedU32 wrapper (mirroring the old pack_u32/unpack_u32 free functions). Box<RemodelMesh> (used in SetMeshResult, boxed only for enum-size reasons, not a DslEnum) got its own impl dsl::DslField for Box<RemodelMesh>, legal via Box's #[fundamental] orphan-rule exception. PackedF32/PackedU8 got thin hand impl dsl::DslField delegating straight to String/Shape::Text (their inner string is already base64 wire format, no double-encoding). All 25+ existing tests preserved unchanged (API-compatible); no new test files added.

Verification (both via CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-remodel-dslconv-target):
- cargo test -p remodel_document: 32 passed, 0 failed (includes default_scene_roundtrips_through_dsl, populated_scene_roundtrips_through_dsl, every_operation_variant_roundtrips_through_op_text, store_roundtrips_through_document_text).
- cargo build -p remodel-plugin: succeeds, zero errors.
- cargo test -p remodel-plugin --lib: 22 passed, 1 failed (__semio_plugin_sanity_declared_apps_appear_in_bundle_manifest, panics on "invalid catalog icon name" in ui/wgpu/rs/../../../ui/asset/icon/generated/icon_name.rs) — this is the documented pre-existing failure from a concurrent human session's in-progress ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs edit, unrelated to this change.

No other remodel/* sub-crates (camera/dense/engine/feature/geo/image/mesh/motion/sfm/video) or framework/core/vcs/dsl engine crates were touched.
